verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is a hosted media-streaming service that handles customer data, so a no-training privacy posture is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack contains no AI-training opt-out, data-use policy, or training exclusion control. Relay isolation and token-scoped access control are adjacent security features and do not address AI training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
